units.oilBpd: liquids (oil, condensate, NGL, LPG) in barrels per day (annual volume / 365)

units.resOilMbbl: liquids reserves, million barrels (class in resClass, year in resYear)

units.rings: outline rings as Google polylines, 3 decimals, lon first, holes dropped
units.wiki: GEM wiki page; when absent it is https://www.gem.wiki/ + name with spaces as underscores
units.offshore: 1 offshore, 0 onshore, absent when the tracker does not say
units.approx: 1 when the tracker marks the location approximate
